accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should not be lighter than #6E736D on light backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms MUST have a data-testid attribute for QA automation.

pizza_menu_1.description: Slice of pizza being picked up, great for menu item thumbnail

pizza_menu_2.description: Person holding sliced pizza, good for hero or banner

biryani_menu_1.description: Plate of Biryani for Pakistani menu items

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use raw HTML `<select>`, `<input type='date'>`, or native alerts. ALWAYS use Shadcn UI primitives.
Implement Sonner for all toast notifications (success/error).
Never use `transition-all` globally, apply only on interactive components.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Do not center-align the main App container or text globally. Keep text left-aligned unless it's a specific empty state.
Inject Fontshare and Google Fonts links in `index.html` to load Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans.
The Dashboard must feel spacious. Use generous padding (p-6 to p-10) and avoid cramming UI elements.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to every button, form input, and key informational widget.
The WhatsApp Simulator should look exactly like a phone mockup floating inside the dashboard or on the side, complete with realistic chat bubbles and typing indicators.
Ensure the Orders board (Kanban or List) relies heavily on the distinct color badges for instant status recognition.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the provided `image_urls`.
Examine existing components to understand the project's patterns before creating new ones.
